manifest_row.title: BWW Interview: Janie Dee Talks A LITTLE NIGHT MUSIC at Opera Holland Park

screening.main_topic: An interview with actor and producer Janie Dee about theatre reopening during the Covid-19 pandemic and her concert production of A Little Night Music.
screening.climate_relevance: Dee discusses her role in the London Climate Change Festival and ways theatres can reduce their environmental impact, including using natural lighting, consuming less energy, and adopting clean energy.
